main_text.p: MIPHIBOSETH, Ionathæ filius, casu claudus efficitur. 2. Sam. 4. 4. omnes Saulis agri [illi restituuntur, 9. 9. inuenit gratiam coram Dauide, 9.7. parcit ei Dauid, 21.7. appellatur Meribbaal, 1. Paral. 9.40. (i. de ore ignominia.)

MIRACVLA: Miraculis à fide abducens occidendus, Deut. 13.1. &c. miraculum Christi primum, Ioan. 2. 11. miracula Christi non omnia scripta, 20.30.31. doctrinam sequuntur perinde ac tabulas sigilla, Matth. 10.8. Marc. 16. 20. Actor. 4. v. 29 30. Rom. 15 19. Heb. 2.4. miracula tempore Christi futura prædicuntur, Esaiæ 35. v. 5. 6. miracula sunt confirmatio verbi, Marc. 16.17. Pseudoprophetarum, Ierem. 23.32. miracula fidem in Christum comitantur, Marc. 16.17.

MIRACVLORVM finis legitimus, Matth. 9.8. & 15.31. Mar. 2.12. & 7.37. Ioan. 6.14. & 11. 45. & 12. 11. Actor. 9. v. 35. 42. & 14. 15 & 19. 17. Miracula dicuntur signa, Heb. 2. 4. eò quòd aliud repræsentent, quàm quod cernitur, ut quæ nihil aliud sint, quàm veræ doctrinæ sigilla. Dicuntur item prodigia, quòd nouum & insuetum aliquid exhibeant. Et virtutes, quòd excellentis illius diuinæ virtutis extraordinarium specimen edant, miracula edere etiam impiis interdum concessum. Matth. 7. v. 22. 23. & 24. 24. Marci 13.22. Apocal. 13. 13. & 16.14. & 19.20. miracula falsa Antichristi imperio stabiliendo concessa, Matth. 24.24. Marc. 13.22.2. Thessal. 2.9. Vide SIGNA: & PRODIGIA.

Miraculorum exempla: Creatio mundi, Genesis 1.1. Diluuium, 7. v. 19. 21. in diluuio seruata familia Noe. 8.18. Linguarum confusio, 11. 7. Sodomæ & Gomorrhæ excidium, 19.24. Vxoris Loth in salis statuam mutatio, v. 26. Rubus ardens, Exodi 3.2. Virga Mosis in colubrum versa 4. v. 3. 4. Mosis manus leprosa, v. 6. 7. Virga Aaronis in colubrum versa, 7.10. aquæ in sanguinem mutatæ, v. 20. Ranæ, 8.6. Muscæ, v. 24. Vesicarum vlcera, 9.10. Fulgur, grando & ignis, v. 23. 24. 25. Locustæ, 10. v. 12. 13. 14. Tenebræ, v. 22. 23. Psalm. 105. 28. Primogenitorum clades, Exod. 12. 29.

page.notes: Marginal text on the right edge of the neighbouring page is not transcribed. Some lines are partly faint or damaged; readings such as "Vide Idolorum", "Miracula" and the tail of Psalm 105 are as best read. Catchword "Columnæ" at the lower right.
